scripts.db:up: dotenv -e .env -- docker compose -f infra/docker-compose.yml -f infra/docker-compose.data.yml up -d --remove-orphans postgres minio nats local-llm
scripts.db:down: dotenv -e .env -- docker compose -f infra/docker-compose.yml -f infra/docker-compose.data.yml down --remove-orphans
scripts.stack:up: dotenv -e .env -- docker compose -f infra/docker-compose.yml up -d postgres temporal temporal-ui traefik
scripts.temporal:ensure-namespace: dotenv -e .env -- docker compose -f infra/docker-compose.yml exec -T temporal sh -c 'until tctl --address temporal:7233 cluster health >/dev/null 2>&1; do sleep 1; done; tctl --address temporal:7233 namespace describe default >/dev/null 2>&1 || tctl --address temporal:7233 namespace register default --description "Default namespace" --retention 72h'
scripts.check:web-auth: PLAYWRIGHT_BROWSERS_PATH=.playwright dotenv -e .env -- npx playwright test tests/web-auth.spec.ts --project=chromium
scripts.check:metadata-auth: PLAYWRIGHT_BROWSERS_PATH=.playwright dotenv -e .env -- npx playwright test tests/metadata-auth.spec.ts --project=chromium
scripts.check:metadata-lifecycle: PLAYWRIGHT_BROWSERS_PATH=.playwright dotenv -e .env -- npx playwright test tests/metadata-lifecycle.spec.ts --project=chromium
scripts.migrate: dotenv -e .env -- pnpm --filter @platform/cdm exec -- prisma migrate deploy --schema prisma/schema.prisma
scripts.migrate:dev: dotenv -e .env -- pnpm --filter @platform/cdm exec -- prisma migrate dev --schema prisma/schema.prisma
scripts.migrate:deploy: dotenv -e .env -- pnpm --filter @platform/cdm exec -- prisma migrate deploy --schema prisma/schema.prisma
scripts.migrate:status: dotenv -e .env -- pnpm --filter @platform/cdm exec -- prisma migrate status --schema prisma/schema.prisma
scripts.prisma:generate: dotenv -e .env -- pnpm --filter @platform/cdm exec -- prisma generate --schema prisma/schema.prisma
scripts.prisma:generate:metadata: rm -rf apps/metadata-api/prisma && cp -R prisma/metadata apps/metadata-api/prisma && export METADATA_DATABASE_URL=$(dotenv -e .env -- node scripts/metadata/resolve-db-url.cjs) && PRISMA_GENERATE_SKIP_AUTOINSTALL=1 dotenv -e .env -- pnpm --dir apps/metadata-api prisma generate --schema prisma/schema.prisma
scripts.migrate:metadata: rm -rf apps/metadata-api/prisma && cp -R prisma/metadata apps/metadata-api/prisma && export METADATA_DATABASE_URL=$(dotenv -e .env -- node scripts/metadata/resolve-db-url.cjs) && dotenv -e .env -- pnpm --dir apps/metadata-api prisma migrate deploy --schema prisma/schema.prisma
scripts.migrate:metadata:dev: rm -rf apps/metadata-api/prisma && cp -R prisma/metadata apps/metadata-api/prisma && export METADATA_DATABASE_URL=$(dotenv -e .env -- node scripts/metadata/resolve-db-url.cjs) && dotenv -e .env -- pnpm --dir apps/metadata-api prisma migrate dev --schema prisma/schema.prisma
scripts.migrate:metadata:status: rm -rf apps/metadata-api/prisma && cp -R prisma/metadata apps/metadata-api/prisma && export METADATA_DATABASE_URL=$(dotenv -e .env -- node scripts/metadata/resolve-db-url.cjs) && dotenv -e .env -- pnpm --dir apps/metadata-api prisma migrate status --schema prisma/schema.prisma
scripts.start:core: pnpm prisma:generate && pnpm build:reporting-packages && pnpm migrate:core && pnpm dev:api-stack:workers
scripts.start:reporting: pnpm prisma:generate:reporting && pnpm migrate:reporting && pnpm dev:reporting-stack:workers
scripts.start:metadata: pnpm prisma:generate:metadata && pnpm migrate:metadata && pnpm dev:metadata-stack
scripts.start: pnpm start:infra && concurrently --kill-others --names "core,reporting,metadata,web,designer" "pnpm start:core" "pnpm start:reporting" "pnpm start:metadata" "pnpm dev:web" "pnpm dev:designer"
